# Radoslav Radev Predicts That Slow And Controlled Planche Lean Presses Build Strength And Feeling For Real Planche Attempts

Radoslav Radev predicts that planche lean presses done with focus on quality, slow and controlled, will build strength and feeling for your real planche attempts. [src: vid-5zALUKd7h3g @ 07:23]

## Details

- He says that if you focus on the quality and the feeling of the muscles, slow and controlled, he is definitely sure you will build really good strength and feeling for your real planche attempts. [src: vid-5zALUKd7h3g @ 07:23]

## Evidence

- vid-5zALUKd7h3g @ 07:23 (Radoslav Radev): "just to focus on the quality on this exercise the feeling of the muscles slow and controlled and then i'm definitely sure you will build really good strength and feeling for your real planche attempts"
